csv_project_name: PDS for I-65 Various Locations Access Control Projects
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to provide Project Development Services Access Control - Projects at various locations within the Seymour District; I-65 at mile marker 4 (Verterans Parkway), I-65 at mile marker 41 (SR-250), I-65 at mile marker 76 (US-31, Taylorsville), I-65 at mile marker 97 (Worthsville Road) and I-74 at mile marker 169 (US-52, West Harrison) . The selected firm will also be responsible for: Environmental Document, Permit Applications, Topographic Survey, Design and Plan Development, Right-of-Way Plan Development (including Right-of-Way Engineering, Title Research, and Staking), Real Estate Acquisition Services (including Right-of-Way Management, Appraising, Review Appraising, Buying, Closing, and Relocations, as needed), Utility and Railroad Coordination, Subsurface Utility Exploration (SUE), Wetland Mitigation, Construction Phase Services, and other related services as needed. Ecological Surveys, Archaeological Investigations, and Historical/Architectural Investigation may be included later if these work types become necessary. 1 ) I 65, Access Control, from 0.5 mi S of SR 250 to 0.5 mi N of SR 250 (SR-250 interchange) , in Jackson Co . 2) I 74, Access Control, from 0.5 mi W of US 52 to 0.5 mi E of US 52 (US-52, West Harrison) , in Dearborn Co . 3) I 65, Access Control, from 7.25 mi N of SR 44 to 8.25 mi N of SR 44 (Worthsville Road) , in Johnson Co . 4) I 65, Access Control, from 1.5 mi S of I-265 to 0.5 mi S of I-265 (Veteran's Parkway) , in Clark Co . 5 ) I 65, Access Control, from 0.5 mi S of US 31 to 0.5 mi N of US 31 (Taylorsville) , in Bartholomew Co
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Archaeology, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Habitat Restoration/Wetlands Restoration
